comment: Hand-drawn Hot Fuzz Professional (NPN version, Rev 002, 2000) by Aron Nelson. Three 2N388A germanium stages and a J201 buffer, based on the Tone Bender Mk II and the Sweet Thing tone stack.
uncertain: 5K emitter control: drawn as a variable resistor with no 'T' mark; could be a panel pot or a trimmer
rows: FET gate: series from the 500k pot, and gate to tone network
FET source and the tone network
input, Q1 to Q2 coupling, and to the highs trim
emitter-bypass control, wired as variable resistor to the 22uF; could be a trimmer
marked '100KT': Q2 collector, Q2 bias and Q3 collector
